151dc0a02c21288bbb1bc0ed38dba74591f65c4b.summary: Orange Cyberdefense CERT report (8 April 2026) on malvertising intrusions that delivered the SmokedHam backdoor, disguised as RVTools or Remote Desktop Manager installers. One intrusion ended in Qilin ransomware deployment. The report associates the cluster with moderate confidence to UNC2465, a financially motivated actor linked to ransomware affiliate work. It also describes SmokedHam variants, use of employee monitoring software, Cloudflare and AWS infrastructure, and the related Cacciatore Python backdoor.

actors.q: With a moderate confidence level, we associate the activity cluster responsible for our SmokedHam and Qilin infection with UNC2465.
actors.by: the report (Orange Cyberdefense CERT), moderate confidence

actors.q: indicate the threat actor behind this intrusion is part of the Qilin Ransomware-as-a-Service.
Qilin is operated by a threat group tracked as REVENANT SPIDER (aka Water Galura, Spikey Scorpius, Pestilent Mantis, Gold Feather).
Also known as Storm-0241, UNC2465 is a Russian-speaking financially motivated threat group that has been active since at least mid-2019.
While UNC2465 was historically affiliated to the DarkSide Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS)
we suspect it might also have been associated with the following RaaS: LockBit, and Hunters International.

hedges: The UNC2465 association is made with moderate confidence.
The report says it is highly likely UNC2465 outsources some malware distribution to traffers.
A possible past association with LockBit and Hunters International is only suspected.
The Qilin deployment implies UNC2465 possibly became a Qilin affiliate at some point in 2025.
Date and uptime checks may reflect either sandbox evasion or development artifacts from testing.
Victim-triage checks are suspected and might not be systematic.
A single operator or developer iterating on tooling is strongly suggested, not confirmed.
Affiliation between SmokedHam and Cacciatore is reasonably inferred from shared delivery tooling, not directly proven.
